sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case examines the tax treatment of corporate distributions. The core issue is whether a shareholder can claim a tax-free return of capital for funds taken from a corporation while acting in a non-shareholder capacity.

paragraphs: This case defines the boundary between shareholder and non-shareholder financial actions. It determines how taxpayers calculate their tax liability on corporate distributions. It clarifies the legal standard for claiming a return of capital.
